info.name: VoxDesk Published API
info.description: Generated from the FastAPI OpenAPI schema: 93 published operations. Internal endpoints are excluded. Set baseUrl and accessToken before use; public widget/demo endpoints have their own key and abuse-gate requirements.

request.description:
Get Public Analytics Summary

Keep tenant-private metrics out of the public endpoint; no synthetic zeros.

Budget

Today's counters for this key. Read-only; consumes nothing.

Create Chat Session

Open a chat session for the embedded chat widget.

Gates run cheapest-first — key and origin, then toll-fraud heuristics, then captcha, then the daily budget — so a bot cannot make the server do expensive work before being refused.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Submit Contact Sales

Contact-sales submission, rate limited per IP.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Demo Status

Everything the public page needs, and nothing about any tenant.

Create Demo Call

Place one demo call, or explain precisely why not.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Request Verification

Send a one-time code to a number the visitor claims to control.

Nothing is dialled until that code is confirmed, which is what stops the demo being pointed at somebody else's phone.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Confirm Verification

Confirm the code and add the number to the demo allow-list.

Single use, expires in 15 minutes, and five wrong attempts lock the number until a new code is requested.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Public Health

Report this endpoint's liveness without implying DB/cache/provider readiness.

Get Public Home

Return public labels and route-registration evidence, not runtime readiness.

Verify

Validate a session token minted by `/redeem`.

The voice and chat bootstraps call this instead of trusting the browser's
copy of the claims: an expired or tampered token has to be refused by the
server, not by a client that had already given up.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Describe

What this link is, without consuming a use.

Redeem

Consume one use and return a short-lived session token.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Public Site Manifest

Public route manifest for the marketing site.

Public Site Pricing

Public pricing data, generated from the plan catalogue so the page cannot quote a price the product will not charge.

Public Route Boundary Check

Whether a path belongs to the marketing site or the application, so the edge never shows a marketing page to a signed-in user.

Public Site Status

Public status summary. Component names and up/degraded only — never internals, never tenant data.

List Use Cases

GET /api/v1/public/use-cases — Public catalog with search, category filter, pagination.
Query params validated via UseCaseQuery schema, safe, no tenant data.

List Categories

GET /api/v1/public/use-cases/categories — Backend-driven category list, no invented counts.

Health

Public health check

Get Use Case Detail

GET /api/v1/public/use-cases/{slug} — Detail page, supports direct deep links.
Slug validated, safe, no tenant leakage.

Create Voice Demo Session

Create a durable DB-backed public voice demo session with an HMAC session token.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Get Voice Demo Session

Return durable public demo session state (requires valid HMAC session token).

End Voice Demo Session

Terminate an active public voice demo session.

Post Voice Demo Event

Process a verified voice-demo lifecycle event (start/turn/interrupt/stop) against PostgreSQL/SQLite.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Post Voice Demo Turn

Process one conversational demo turn against the persisted session.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Get Widget Chat Js

Serve the text chat widget (`widget/chat.js`).

Same origin, same headers as `embed.js`: a customer embedding the chat
widget must not have to whitelist a second host, and the file must not be
sniffed into another type.

Get Widget Config

Configuration for an embedded widget, resolved from the request Origin.

Returns only what a web page may know: product name, colours, position and the session endpoint. A key presented from an origin not on the key's allowlist is refused.

Get Widget Embed Js

Serve the CSP-safe embeddable widget loader (`widget/embed.js`).

Start Widget Session

Open a widget session.

The only unauthenticated route that can spend money, so it passes the abuse gates — captcha, budget, toll-fraud heuristics — before a session row exists. Every refusal names the gate that fired.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Read Widget Session

Read a widget session's state and turns.

The session token is the credential; there is no other lookup path.

Terminate Widget Session

End a widget session. Idempotent; ending an ended session returns its final state.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Post Widget Session Message

Send one visitor message and return the agent's reply.

Blocking on purpose: a widget that returns a message id and polls is a widget that feels broken.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Create Widget Voice Bootstrap

Return the real web-call bootstrap (public key + origin check) when configured, or NOT_CONFIGURED otherwise.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

List Widget Public Keys

List this workspace's widget public keys.

Never returns the key itself — only its prefix, label, allowed origins and last-used timestamp.

Create Widget Public Key

Create a public key for the embedded widget.

The plaintext key is returned **once**. Only its hash is stored, so a database dump cannot be used to impersonate a widget.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Get Widget Public Key

Read one widget public key by id.

Scoped to the caller's workspace; an id belonging to another workspace is a 404, not a 403, so the endpoint cannot be used to enumerate ids.

Update Widget Public Key

Update a key's label, allowed origins or agent binding.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Revoke Widget Public Key

Revoke a public key immediately.

Idempotent: revoking an already-revoked key succeeds and changes nothing.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Rotate Widget Public Key

Rotate a public key, returning the new plaintext once.

The previous key keeps working for a grace window so a tenant's live site does not break mid-deploy; revoke it explicitly to end that window early.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Get Billing

Read this workspace's billing status.

Returns the plan, subscription state, current period and the estimated overage for the period so far. Every field is an allowlist: no provider identifiers, no API keys, no payment instrument.

Get Billing

Read this workspace's billing status.

Returns the plan, subscription state, current period and the estimated overage for the period so far. Every field is an allowlist: no provider identifiers, no API keys, no payment instrument.

Cancel Subscription

Cancel at the end of the current period.

Immediate cancellation is deliberately not offered: it would forfeit usage the customer has already been billed for.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Change Plan

Upgrade immediately, or schedule a downgrade for the period end.

The policy is implemented once, in `service.change_plan`, and documented
there and in `docs/BILLING.md`.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Start Checkout

Begin a purchase.

Returns a URL and nothing else. **No subscription state is established
here** — a browser reaching the success URL has proved only that it
reached a URL. Only a verified webhook makes a subscription active.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Itemised Invoice Lines

This period's usage, priced per component against the current book.

List Invoices

Invoice metadata.

Served from the local mirror rather than by calling Stripe on every page
load: it is faster, it works when Stripe is down, and it keeps the API
key out of a read path that a dashboard polls.

Issue

Mint a signed licence for a self-hosted installation.

Owner-only. The signature is HMAC over the licence claims, so the installation can verify itself offline.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Verify

Verify a licence signature and its claims.

Unauthenticated because a self-hosted installation has no account with us; the signature is the credential.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Margin Report

Cost against charge for this period — the reseller's view.

A tenant administrator sees their own margin (they are the reseller to
*their* customers). Nobody sees another tenant's: the query is scoped to
``ctx.tenant_id`` exactly like every other read here.

List Plans

List the plans a workspace can buy.

Server-owned catalogue. A browser can name a plan *code* but never a price; the code is resolved to a provider price id server-side.

Open Portal

Open the customer portal for **the authenticated tenant's** customer.

There is no request body. The external customer id is read from the
tenant's own row, so there is no parameter through which another tenant's
id could be supplied (requirement 9).

Get Price Book

The price book in force now, or a specific published version.

Publish Price Book

Publish a new immutable version. Existing versions are never edited.

There is no PATCH and no DELETE on purpose: an invoice that cites version
``2026-01`` must still mean the same numbers a year later.

Guarded by ``get_platform_admin``, which currently denies every principal:
prices are deploy-scoped, so a tenant administrator must not move them for
everyone. Until a platform-operator principal exists, a price change is a
release — see ``docs/PRICE_BOOK.md``. Denying is the correct interim
behaviour; inventing a superuser flag to make the endpoint "work" would be a
privilege-escalation hole hidden behind a convenience.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

List Price Book Versions

Every published price-book version, oldest first.

Versions are immutable. An invoice cites the version it was priced with, so re-deriving an old invoice reproduces the old numbers exactly.

Reconcile

Re-read the provider and rebuild the usage cache.

The "something looks wrong" button. Safe by construction: the provider is
always authoritative on subscription state, and rebuilding a summary only
touches a cache.

Get Usage

Metered usage for the current billing period.

One entry per metric with included, used, remaining and overage. The counters come from append-only usage events, so the figure is reproducible after any dispute.

Usage By Provider

Usage split by provider and by day, from the same rows.

One query, one pivot: a "by day" chart computed separately from the "by
provider" table is how the two disagree by a few minutes and the customer
notices before we do.

Receive Webhook

Provider events.

Unauthenticated by necessity — Stripe has no VoxDesk credential — and
therefore **signature-verified before anything else**.

`await request.body()` gives the exact bytes as received. Nothing parses
the JSON before verification: requirement 21 is explicit that a
re-serialized body invalidates the signature, and reading `request.json()`
here would silently make every signature check meaningless.

Always returns 2xx once the signature passes. A non-2xx makes Stripe
retry, and retrying an event we have already recorded, or one nobody will
ever handle, is pure noise. Genuine handler failures are the exception:
those return 500 so Stripe *does* retry.

List Assets

List uploaded brand assets (logos, favicons).

Upload Asset

Upload a logo or favicon. The bytes are validated and SVGs are sanitised.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Delete Asset

Delete a brand asset. A theme still referencing it falls back to no logo rather than a broken image.

Read Asset

Asset metadata by id.

Read Asset Content

Serve the stored bytes with the sniffed content type and a tight CSP.

Read Branding

This tenant's branding, projected for one surface.

``GET /theme`` returns the raw payload an editor edits. This returns what a
*renderer* needs and nothing else: CSS custom properties, document metadata,
or the widget's config, plus a ``coverage`` block naming any field that still
carries the vendor's name. The distinction matters because a support engineer
answering "why does my dashboard still say VoxDesk" needs the projection and
its coverage report, not the theme JSON.

List Domains

List this workspace's claimed hostnames.

Includes their verification and certificate state, so an operator can see which are live.

Claim Domain

Claim a hostname. The ownership token is returned **once**, in this response.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Delete Domain

Release a hostname claim.

After this the hostname resolves to nothing and will receive no branded document.

Read Domain

Read one hostname's claim.

Read Certificate

The certificate state for one hostname.

A certificate is only issued after the domain is ACTIVE; before that this reports the reason rather than a placeholder.

Read Domain Checks

The DNS checks for one hostname, with the resolver answers that produced them.

Disable Domain

Stop serving one hostname immediately.

The reason is recorded in the audit trail; the claim itself is kept so re-enabling does not require DNS proof again.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Enable Domain

Resume serving a disabled hostname.

Refresh Certificate

Request a renewed certificate for one hostname.

Verify Domain

Re-run the DNS checks for one hostname.

Idempotent; a claim that already passes returns ACTIVE without changing anything.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

List Sender Domains

List verified sending domains for outgoing email.

Create Sender Domain

Claim a sending domain.

Sending stays off until SPF, DKIM and DMARC all pass; this endpoint returns the records to publish.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Delete Sender Domain

Remove a sending domain.

Read Sender Records

The DNS records a sending domain must publish.

Verify Sender Domain

Re-check a sending domain's DNS records.

Public Widget Config

Widget configuration for an authorised embedding origin.

Public Widget Loader

The script a tenant's site loads.

Resolved from ``Host`` **and** the public key: the host decides the tenant, the
key is checked against that tenant so a key copied from one tenant's page
cannot be used to pull another tenant's theme onto a domain that is not theirs.
A host we do not serve is a 404 — never the default theme.

List Templates

The branded email templates this deployment can render.

Preview Template

Render a branded email with the active theme, for the console's preview pane.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Read Theme

The theme payload an editor edits, plus its published version and the allowed fonts.

Publish Theme

Publish a new immutable theme version, optionally activating it.

Contrast is validated first; a theme that fails is refused with the failing pairs listed.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

Validate Theme Endpoint

Dry-run validation, so the editor can show contrast failures before saving.

This endpoint *reports*; it never raises. A theme editor that has to parse a 422
to colour a field red is one that will show the failure in the wrong place, so
the errors come back in the body keyed by the field they belong to.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.

List Theme Versions

Theme version history, newest first.

Activate Theme Version

Repoint the active theme at an earlier version.

A rollback is a pointer move: no row is rewritten, so the history stays intact.

Read Widget Admin

The widget configuration as this workspace configured it.

Distinct from the public endpoint, which resolves the same theme by request Host.

List Templates

The gallery. Flows are omitted: they are large and the list is a menu.

Read Template

One starter template in full: flow, tools, variables, analysis schema, simulation cases, compliance notes.

Instantiate Template

Create a draft agent from a template.

The result is always a draft: a template that went straight to live would be a production agent nobody reviewed. 409 if the derived external key is already taken in this workspace.

Review example values and replace placeholders before sending.
